install_startup.recipe_modification_note: The project's own docker-compose-image-tag.yml uses apachesuperset.docker.scarf.sh/apache/superset (a pull-count analytics proxy in front of the real image) - pointed the same compose file at apache/superset directly on Docker Hub instead, the real underlying image, reached via the org's already-allowed Docker Hub route. superset-init's own dependency-resolution step (uv installing postgres requirements from PyPI) hit the same TLS-interception gap fixed for shiptrack (task #13) - added SSL_CERT_FILE/REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE pointing at the proxy's CA, copied into the compose file's own mounted ./docker directory. Also edited the LOCAL copy of docker/docker-init.sh (bind-mounted into the container, not the published image) to create the admin account as libwalker@example.com instead of the hardcoded admin@superset.com, since the username is otherwise unconfigurable and this pipeline's own crawler had no way to know to type 'admin'.
